visual.observation: A BitClub personal landing page visibly presents the phrase “Real Passive Income” alongside a “Take a FREE tour!” prompt, a sign-up form, and a reference to a BitClub network page.
visual.context: Promotional landing-page context is visible; the sampled frame does not establish whether the offer was completed or delivered.
visual.potential_relevance: A passive-income claim is directly linked to an invitation to take a tour and sign up, creating a reward/action relationship that may merit review.
visual.limitations: The frame does not show the full terms, any payment or transfer step, actual earnings, or whether the page was operated by an authorized entity.

visual.observation: A Facebook post describes replacing or increasing income through a business opportunity and visibly refers to recruiting or bringing in more people, with a link or contact invitation in the post.
visual.context: The content appears as a repeated promotional post in Facebook pages or groups; the sampled text is partially small and not all conditions are legible.
visual.potential_relevance: An income-related claim is connected to recruitment and an external contact or destination, which is a task-relevant relationship for review.
visual.limitations: These frames do not establish payment made, losses, the exact destination, the complete recruitment terms, or the identity or authorization of the poster.

visual.observation: A BitClub webpage shows a table of member or pool entries with Bitcoin-denominated amounts and labels such as mining-pool or membership-related activity.
visual.context: The table is shown within a BitClub-branded website; the sampled frame does not show how the amounts were obtained or what action was required.
visual.potential_relevance: Displayed Bitcoin amounts associated with membership or pool activity provide a visible return-related representation that may merit contextual review when considered with the site's promotional material.
visual.limitations: The frame cannot establish that the amounts are real payouts, guaranteed returns, payments by viewers, or evidence of any transaction outcome.

textual_context_notes.observation: The description frames the promotional message as a contrast with revshares and ponzi schemes that allegedly shut down or disappear with people's money.

visual_context_notes.observation: A prominent on-screen disclaimer states “Everything is a risk. Nothing is guaranteed.” and says that the amount earned depends on how much work is put into building the business.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because the speaker promotes BitClub Network through a $99 lifetime membership, referral-based earnings claims, and instructions to conceal the business name while routing signups through a cloaked referral link. Although an on-screen disclaimer acknowledges risk and says earnings depend on work, it does not remove the observed recruitment and paid-membership solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video's central content is a recruitment strategy: it teaches viewers to obtain referrals, place recruits in a binary tree, and use promotional links and social-media posts to build a network. Paid mining-pool participation and claimed withdrawals are also presented as part of the same BitClub Network offer, supporting S04 as a secondary mechanism.
